ruleDefinitions.name: Regsvr32 DLL Execution With Uncommon Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a "regsvr32" execution where the DLL doesn't contain a common file extension.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ax.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ocx.*")) OR process_command_line = "None" OR process_command_line = "") AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ppl.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bav.*"))
